$comment: One statement of each wire contract, answered by the zod schema, the Rust validator, and the Swift decoder. A write is answered by the schema that guards it and a read by the schema a client reads with. A payload accepted by one runtime and refused by another is the drift this file exists to catch.

quota_snapshot_envelope.name: a retired data version is refused
an envelope naming its own device is refused
an envelope naming a sequence is refused
a snapshot naming a retired stamp is refused
a snapshot naming its collector is refused
a percentage outside the meter is refused
a generation of zero is refused

usage_submission.name: a device uploads one rescanned hour
an hour with nothing in it is accepted
a retired data version is refused
an hour computed from a missing lower bound is refused
an instant that is not an hour boundary is refused
one hour named twice is refused
two rows with one identity are refused
a row naming another agent than its upload is refused
cache tokens exceeding input tokens are refused
an agent the Account does not accept is refused
a row that still names its own hour is refused
a key the contract does not name is refused

account_summary.name: an account with one device and one reading
a retired data version is refused
a key this build does not know is kept, not refused
account_summary.reason: a reader may be older than the Relay it reads

account_summary.name: a source snapshot that is not a quota reading is refused
a provider id this build has not heard of is read as unknown
an agent this build has not heard of is read as unknown
usage attributed to every inference provider is accepted
quota sent as the observations it is resolved from is refused

account_usage_activity.name: a single UTC day with its agent tree
daily totals without an agent tree
a null agents field is refused
an agent this build has not heard of is read as unknown
